_about: n-Hexane (1) + Toluene (2): isothermal total pressures at 313.2 K. Rows: temperature in K, liquid mole fraction of n-hexane, pressure in kPa, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record. Rows with x_1 = 0 and 1 are the pure-component pressures measured with the same set.
